Baby Saja

Korean: 배비 사자

Group (2025-present):
Saja Boys

Introduction

Baby Saja is a fictional rapper created for the 2025 Netflix film Kpop Demon Hunters. He is the main rapper and youngest member of the fictional boy group Saja Boys. Danny Chung, a Korean-American rapper and songwriter under THEBLACKLABEL, provides his singing and rapping voice. Chung is known for his work with BLACKPINK, Jeon Somi, and CL. While Baby doesn't have spoken dialogue in the film, his rap lines, delivered by Chung, have received particular attention for their intensity.

Baby's feature is inspired by Stray Kids' Hyunjin and BTS's Jungkook during his "Golden" era. This gives him the look of a cute but chaotic youngest member. Do not let his name fool you. Baby is not innocent. He delivers quick lines, unsettling smiles, and an unpredictable energy that make him the real wildcard of Saja Boys. He's the member most likely to charm unsuspecting fans and then leave them completely shattered.
